mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing the air sacs and capillaries together was most worthwhile: the arrows clearly showed oxygen and carbon dioxide moving in opposite directions without air and blood mixing.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the branching airways was clear but predictable, especially as it was the only combination offered at that point.

surprise.text: The exchange picture clarified that gases cross thin walls without air bubbling into the blood.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The elastic tissue's purpose was initially suggested by its stretch-and-recoil picture and became clearer in the result.

continue.text: I would probably continue: connecting the air route to the gas-exchange surface made me curious about how the lungs work with the rest of the body, though the last steps were predictable.
